Market today: Tech is under pressure, with big names like Microsoft facing skeptical investors after a Google report sparked a sell-off. This mood directly impacts your chip and tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.97%) and SPAL (-54.69%) are deep in the red, leveraged, and well below their stops. QQQ (-5.48%) and QQQI (-7.69%) are also nearing their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on QQQ and SMH for continued weakness or a bounce. The broader tech sentiment remains fragile.

Bottom line: Focus on disciplined risk management and respecting your stops in this volatile tech environment.
plays: Trim SOXL (-56.97%) and SPAL (-54.69%) given their deep losses, leveraged nature, and being well below stops. Leveraged ETFs decay and drops are amplified on margin.
Watch QQQ (stop 670) and QQQI (stop 52) closely. Respect stops to protect capital in a volatile tech market.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
